compiled_state.title: RED: test config keys preconditions.inference_review.rate_* with floor enforcement
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Write failing tests asserting the inference_review config keys exist in dso-config.conf and that the config validator rejects rate_high_stakes < 100.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-config-inference-review-validator.sh

## Test cases
- .claude/dso-config.conf contains 'preconditions.inference_review.rate_rationale' key with default value 20
- .claude/dso-config.conf contains 'preconditions.inference_review.rate_high_stakes' key with default value 100
- Running the config validator with rate_high_stakes=99 exits non-zero
- Running the config validator with rate_high_stakes=100 exits zero
- Running the config validator with rate_high_stakes=50 exits non-zero with an error message mentioning 'floor' or 'minimum 100'
- rate_rationale accepts values 0-100 (validator accepts rate_rationale=0 and rate_rationale=100)
- CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md contains the string 'preconditions.inference_review' (documents the new keys)

## Config validation integration
The floor check must integrate into the existing config-validation entry point (validate.sh or preconditions-validator-lib.sh), NOT as a standalone script.

## Gate
RED — tests must FAIL before config changes are made
